findings.title: deposit does not show how many steakUSDT shares the signer receives; the vault price sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 0: signer receives 6981.124342392283465208 steakUSDT; screen shows only 'Share ticker: steakUSDT'.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor: the share amount is not in calldata and the function has no minimum-shares parameter.

effects: The signer sends USDT to the vault; the amount comes from the vault price (`_convertToAssetsWithTotals`, ceil) and has no maximum in calldata. Only the signer's USDT allowance to the vault limits it.
The vault mints exactly `shares` steakUSDT to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", a constant "Deposit asset: USDT" without an amount, the exact share amount in steakUSDT and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDT leaves the signer; the vault price sets it with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` Descriptor field: {"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}.
findings.fix: None for the amount: it is not in calldata. Consider the label "Pay with (amount set by share price)" so the signer knows the USDT amount is not fixed.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns steakUSDT shares from `owner`; the amount comes from the vault price (ceil) and is not in calldata. When `owner` is not the caller, this spends the owner's share allowance to the caller.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDT to `receiver`, after it withdraws that USDT from Morpho Blue markets.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", "Withdraw exactly" USDT amount, the recipient "To" and "Owner".

findings.title: withdraw never says steakUSDT shares are burned from the owner; the label is only "Owner".
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);` Descriptor withdraw field `owner` label "Owner". Case 1: signer burns 506764.733871460997796087 steakUSDT; the screen does not name steakUSDT.
findings.fix: Change the `owner` label to "Burn steakUSDT shares from".

findings.title: withdraw does not show the number of shares burned; the vault price sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` Case 1: 506764.73 steakUSDT leave the signer, no amount on screen.
findings.fix: None: the share amount is not in calldata and there is no max-shares parameter.

cases.notes: USDT in 561617.234664 to signer shown exactly. steakUSDT out: owner shown, but the asset and amount (506764.73) are not shown.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` steakUSDT from `owner`; when `owner` is not the caller, this spends the owner's share allowance to the caller.
The vault sends USDT to `receiver`; the amount comes from the vault price (floor) and has no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the share amount in steakUSDT, the recipient "To" and "Owner"; the asset received is not named.

findings.title: redeem does not name USDT as the asset the recipient receives, though it is a fixed constant.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` Descriptor redeem fields: only `shares`, `receiver`, `owner`. Case 2: signer receives 111.353758 USDT; reader: 'Which token is paid out; I assume USDT from the name'.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, as the mint format does.

findings.title: redeem does not show how much USDT the signer receives; the vault price sets it, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Case 2: 111.353758 USDT arrive, no amount on screen.
findings.fix: None: the amount is not in calldata and the function has no minimum-assets parameter.

cases.notes: steakUSDT out 100.107981805511742051 shown exactly. USDT in: the screen names neither the asset nor the amount (111.353758); the reader guessed USDT.
